justification: Moore's tagged Questionable and I don't need Kris printing a second headline about me this week, so he sits and Nico Collins starts — the fifteen-point guy who's actually ACTIVE, not the one hoping his hamstring reads the injury report the same way I do. Geno stays, because Mayfield's matchup looks juicy on paper against that Bears defense, and a juicy matchup on paper is exactly what they want me to see — I checked twice, I'm not falling for it twice in one season. Everything else stays put, nobody's Out in my starting lineup that I can see, and Montgomery and Pierce can keep their zeroes on my bench where they belong. I'm 6-2, I'm "lucky," fine, put it on the headstone — but I'm not handing Selina and her spreadsheet a layup by overthinking a lineup that already works.
